note: Small Chippewa NF campground on Webster Lake, about 10 mi south of Blackduck via County Road 39 and Forest Roads 2207 and 2236, in hardwood forest along the shore, with a beach access, picnic area, boat launch and a large trail system. --Claude
summary: Rec.gov (FCFS scan-and-pay record) and FS page read: 15 nonelectric sites, all first come, $14, vault toilets, no drinking water, no showers; season from rec.gov 05-09..10-14 (FS says 5/22-10/13). Not waterfront kept, possible lakeview for 09-11 flagged. Phone corrected.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront kept; possible lakeview for the reviewer. On Esri imagery every site is under continuous hardwood canopy; sites 09 (47.60336,-94.50935), 10 (47.60280,-94.50978) and 11 (47.60253,-94.50970) sit about 35-45 m from the Webster Lake shore, 07 about 50 m, the rest 70 m+. Under canopy that is a view at best, and no photo or catalog attribute confirms one (no site has a water-proximity attribute); no leaf-off MnGeo coverage here.

SEASON: rec.gov first-come season 2026-05-09..10-14 versus the FS page's 5/22/26-10/13/26; written from rec.gov (trust rec.gov), with the FS dates in the note. The FS page now shows 'Closed for the Season'.
PIN 47.60344,-94.50847 is the rec.gov facility point between the north and south site groups; confirmed.
